meaning: The clocks that the values of three scaffold-recordings builds belong to: agricultural science (the dips and open issues of its staged start), and the inserters moved_open names for agricultural science with backed-up belts and for chemical science with a shared foundry. Each build is named as in scaffold-recordings.game.test.ts, its config by the ConfigPaths key; `clock_sha256` is the sha256 of the identity (clockIdentity) of the clock the generator selects for it. The game test refuses to run on another clock and scaffold-recordings-clock.generation.test.ts checks the selection (the two agricultural science builds on the generations of agricultural-science.generation.test.ts and clock-belt.generation.test.ts), so a clock that moves is found before those values are taken for the new clock's. The values were recorded on 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-16 on the same clock (agricultural science: 2 output swings per cycle; chemical science with a shared foundry: 1 output swing per cycle); the hashes were taken from the selection on 2026-10-23, no recording of the clock itself was kept.
